pages.text: For wooden furniture, use the same wood throughout the recipe. The vanilla options are oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, bamboo, crimson, and warped. A framed version takes a custom panel instead.
Cherry planks and slabs produce a cherry shelf.

pages.title: Color Variants
pages.text: Use wool or dye as the recipe calls for. Lamps, lanterns, sword pedestals, and typewriters keep their color when placed and picked up. Right-click one with a dye to recolor it. Carpet styles tables, seats, cases, and desks.
